title: 第3章 林尘必须给我滚出去第4章 御风剑诀圣子皇甫逸
content_zh:
第一卷第3章林尘必须给我滚出去！
武极宗，内宗院落。
林尘在房间打坐修炼，吸收天地灵气，在周身经脉流转，凝练灵力。
这座院落位于灵脉汇聚之地，乃是一处修炼宝地，柳嫣然对林尘很好，安排的地方很不错。
林尘初来乍到，对武极宗的情况还很陌生，且以前身为灵剑宗弟子，与武极宗天骄争锋，得罪了不少人，心中有紧迫感。
现在最重要的事情，就是调整状态，努力修炼，提升实力！
唯有修炼变强，林尘才能在武极宗立足，才能杀回灵剑宗报仇雪恨！
修炼了一夜，林尘的境界恢复到了聚灵七重，距离以前的巅峰状态，已经不远！
突然间，门外响起一阵脚步声。
“轰！”
房门被一脚踹开。
一位黑衣少年闯了进来，脸上满是凶恶之色。
“林尘，听说你在灵剑宗想奸污我表姐苏瑶，被废掉武魂，如今成了废物，可真有意思！”
黑衣少年满脸讥讽，幸灾乐祸。
“赵拓，你来做什么？”
林尘眼神不善。
武极宗内宗弟子赵拓，乃是苏瑶表弟，以前对林尘很客气，林尘还指点过他修行。
“自然是表姐让我来收拾你这废物！”
“你也配在这里修炼？这座院落是我的！
我的！”

赵拓眼神阴冷，这座院落的修炼效果，在内宗是最好的，媲美真传弟子居住的院落。
赵拓觊觎已久，最近花费巨资打点了关系，终于获得长老批准，可以进入此地修炼。
却得知，圣女柳嫣然抢先一步，安排林尘进来了！
在武极宗，圣子和圣女有着极大的权利，不比长老差。
赵拓咽不下这口气，且苏瑶派人传信，让他好好“关照”
林尘，他便直接来抢！
“滚！”
林尘脸色一沉，他现在最紧迫的事情就是修炼变强，去别的地方修炼效果会打折扣，怎么可能轻易将院落让出去。
“林尘，你最好搞清楚！
现在的你只是一个废物！”
“你不滚出去，那我就打断你的双腿，亲手将你丢出去！”
赵拓眼中凶光闪烁。
武极宗明面上不准同门相残，但，只要有靠山，失手重伤同门也不算什么大罪。
“够了！”
侍女雪儿一直在门外候着，见赵拓如此张狂，忍不住说道：“此处院落是我家小姐安排给林公子的，赵拓，你最好想清楚再动手！”
“柳圣女安排一个废物做内宗弟子，本就不合规矩，何况还给他如此珍贵的修炼之地！”
“你若有不服，可以亲自去跟我家小姐理论。”
“区区贱婢，敢如此跟我说话！
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 3 Lin Chen must get out of here!
Wuji Sect, the inner sect courtyard.
Lin Chen meditated in his room, absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, flowing through his meridians, and condensing his spiritual power.
This courtyard is located at a place where spiritual veins gather. It is a treasured place for cultivation. Liu Yanran treats Lin Chen very well and arranges the place very well.
Lin Chen had just arrived and was very unfamiliar with the situation of Wuji Sect. He was a disciple of Lingjian Sect in the past. He competed with the genius of Wuji Sect and offended many people, so he felt a sense of urgency in his heart.
The most important thing now is to adjust your state, practice hard, and improve your strength!
Only by practicing and becoming stronger can Lin Chen gain a foothold in the Wuji Sect and return to the Lingjian Sect for revenge!
After practicing for a night, Lin Chen's state returned to the seventh level of gathering souls, and he was not far from his previous peak state!
Suddenly, there was a sound of footsteps outside the door.
"Boom!"
The door was kicked open.
A young man in black broke in, with a ferocious look on his face.
"Lin Chen, I heard that you tried to rape my cousin Su Yao in the Lingjian Sect, but your martial spirit was abolished and you are now a waste. How interesting!"
The young man in black had a sarcastic face and was gloating about his misfortune.
"Zhao Tuo, what are you doing here?"
Lin Chen's eyes were unkind.
Zhao Tuo, a disciple of Wuji Sect's inner sect, was Su Yao's cousin. He was very polite to Lin Chen in the past, and Lin Chen even taught him how to practice.
"Of course my cousin asked me to clean up this piece of trash like you!"
"Are you worthy of practicing here? This courtyard belongs to me!
Mine! "
Zhao Tuo's eyes were cold. The cultivation effect of this courtyard was the best in the inner sect, comparable to the courtyard where true disciples lived.
Zhao Tuo has been coveting it for a long time. He recently spent a lot of money to build relationships and finally got approval from the elders to enter this place to practice.
But they learned that the saint Liu Yanran took the lead and arranged for Lin Chen to come in!
In Wuji Sect, the Holy Son and Holy Girl have great power, no less than the elders.
Zhao Tuo couldn't swallow this breath, and Su Yao sent someone to send a message asking him to "take good care of" him
Lin Chen, he came directly to snatch it!
"Get out!"
Lin Chen's face darkened. His most urgent thing now was to practice and become stronger. If he went to another place to practice, the effect would be compromised. How could he give up the courtyard so easily?
"Lin Chen, you'd better figure it out!
You are just a waste now! "
"If you don't get out, then I will break your legs and throw you out with my own hands!"
Zhao Tuo's eyes flashed fiercely.
On the surface, Wuji Zong does not allow members of the same sect to kill each other, but as long as there is a backer, it is not a serious crime to accidentally seriously injure a fellow sect member.
"Enough!"
The maid Xue'er had been waiting outside the door. Seeing Zhao Tuo being so arrogant, she couldn't help but said: "My lady arranged this courtyard for Mr. Lin. Zhao Tuo, you'd better think carefully before taking action!"
"Sage Liu arranged for a loser to be an inner sect disciple. It is against the rules, let alone giving him such a precious training ground!"
"If you are dissatisfied, you can argue with my lady in person."
"You're just a bitch, how dare you talk to me like that!
